messages:
maria-ops: quick follow-up from PM-2026 postmortem. need a focused runbook + playbook patch to speed triage and capture recurring mitigations. owners below.
lee-oncall: can we get a <10m triage checklist? last time we lost ~20m finding traces.
nina-eng: I got the checklist. will include exact commands to extract tenant and traces.
omar-ml: I'll add model/kv-cache checks and fallback steps with `--kv-preserve`.
chris-platform: I'll update escalation rules and add a paging matrix.
lee-oncall: checklist draft:
1) nodes/pods: `kubectl get nodes && kubectl get pods -n inference`
2) recent logs: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n inference --since=15m --tail=200`
3) traces: `redwoodctl traces query --tenant 67890 --since 20m`
4) cache stats: `redwoodctl cache stats --model <model> --window 5m`
5) if evictions >30% -> `redwoodctl cache pause --route <route>` then escalate
6) fallback toggle: `redwoodctl route fallback --route <route> --to cpu-backend --kv-preserve`
maria-ops: nina include tenant-extract snippet. add 1-line test for each PR.
nina-eng: snippet: `TENANT=$(kubectl get pod -l app=ingestion -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.labels.tenant}') && redwoodctl traces query --tenant $TENANT --since 30m`
omar-ml: add heuristic: if token latency >2x with stable error-rate -> suspect cache. stagger fallback by 30s per replica.
chris-platform: escalation summary:
- page eng-runtime on P1 or sustained >7% errors for 10m
- page infra for OOM/GPU failures
- page platform-owner for multi-region/tenant impact
incident-bot: Reminder: create follow-up tickets and add owners (auto-reminder 72h).
maria-ops: actions (board ST-9901): nina (checklist, 2d), chris (escalation, 3d), omar (model mitigations, 3d), maria (customer timeline, 4d). PRs please include 1-line summary + test.
lee-oncall: recurring pattern: ingestion large batches -> cache thrash. suggested emergency throttle: `kubectl scale deploy/ingestion-service --replicas=0 -n ingestion` or rate-limit via configurator.
maria-ops: I'll run a 30-min walkthrough next Tue. postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/PM-2026
